subject.title: [Feature]: Add an optional result-return mode for /hooks/agent

question: Should authenticated hook callers be allowed to synchronously receive agent output from `POST /hooks/agent`, and what result, error, timeout, replay, and audit contract should that mode expose?
rationale: Source inspection proves the feature gap, but cleanup automation cannot safely choose a new public Gateway HTTP API and security boundary for reflected agent output.

options.title: Adopt the linked PR shape with hardening
options.body: Use `waitForResult` plus `announceToMain` on the existing endpoint, adding any required size, timeout, concurrency, redaction, and replay constraints before merge.

options.title: Choose a narrower result contract
options.body: Redirect the implementation toward a dedicated sync endpoint, bounded envelope, or short-lived result reference if raw synchronous output is too broad for hook auth.

options.title: Decline core support for now
options.body: Keep the documented async hook plus `sessions_history` workaround and close the linked PR if maintainers decide this should remain downstream-specific.

recommendation.title: Adopt the linked PR shape with hardening
recommendation.body: Use `waitForResult` plus `announceToMain` on the existing endpoint, adding any required size, timeout, concurrency, redaction, and replay constraints before merge.

likelyOwner.reason: This decision spans Gateway HTTP API shape, security posture, and hook endpoint behavior where the recent history is strongest.
